nodes.label: ML-DSA-44 Module-Lattice Digital Signature Algorithm
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 204 Category 1 post-quantum digital signature mechanism parameter set based on the hard problems of Module Learning With Errors (M-LWE) and Module Short Integer Solution (M-SIS).

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Multi-Logical Device (MLD) Architecture
nodes.description: CXL specification component enabling a single physical Type 3 device to present up to 16 virtual/logical memory devices to independent host domain controllers.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Arabic Lemmatization Engine
nodes.description: Morphological generation and analysis component in CAMeL Tools mapping Arabic surface word forms to canonical lemmas using context and disambiguation models.

nodes.label: W3C OWL 2 EL Profile Specification
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation defining a profile of OWL 2 tailored for ontologies with large numbers of classes and properties where reasoning tasks run in polynomial time.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Masked Matrix-Matrix Multiplication (TC) Kernel
nodes.description: Algebraic graph algorithm computing exact triangle counts in undirected networks using masked matrix-matrix multiplication (L <.*L> L^T) over the Plus-Pair semiring.
